description:
The RX310 16-Speed Road Bike is designed for fitness riding, recreational cycling, commuting, and longer rides on paved roads. Built around a lightweight 6061 aluminum frame and a Shimano Claris R2000 16-speed drivetrain, the RX310 combines efficient road performance with practical components for everyday riders.
With a complete bicycle weight of approximately 24 lbs, the RX310 is responsive on the road and manageable when carrying, transporting, or storing the bike. The alloy straight-blade fork provides direct, predictable steering, while the classic drop-bar design offers multiple hand positions for shorter rides and longer paved routes.
The Shimano Claris R2000 drivetrain includes front and rear derailleurs with STI integrated shift and brake levers. Riders can change gears and operate the brakes while keeping their hands in a natural position on the hoods. A compact 50/34T crankset paired with an 11–32T cassette provides a practical gear range for flatter roads, rolling terrain, moderate climbs, and everyday fitness riding.
The RX310 rolls on 700C × 28C Kenda tires designed for efficient riding on paved roads. The 28C tire width provides a practical balance of road efficiency, stability, and everyday comfort. Tektro R315 dual-pivot caliper brakes offer controlled braking with a lightweight and straightforward design.
New Road Cyclists: An accessible introduction to drop-bar road cycling with Shimano STI integrated shifting.
Fitness and Recreational Riders: Lightweight construction and practical gearing for exercise rides, weekend cycling, and longer paved routes.
Commuters: An efficient option for riders who prefer the riding position and handling of a traditional road bike.
The RX310 focuses on the features that matter for everyday road riding: lightweight aluminum construction, Shimano Claris components, integrated shifting, practical gearing, and an approximate weight of 24 lbs.
The RX310 is intended primarily for paved-road riding. It is not designed for mountain biking, technical trails, stunt riding, jumping, or downhill use.
